name: Invoice Intake Agent
purpose: Review incoming invoices for completeness, extraction quality, and downstream suitability.
primary_kpis: Extraction confidence rate, intake cycle time, misroute rate

name: Invoice Validation Agent
purpose: Validate invoice header and line data against business rules and master data.
primary_kpis: Validation accuracy, false-positive rate, field-level error rate

name: Matching Agent
purpose: Perform PO, price, quantity, and receipt matching with tolerance analysis.
primary_kpis: Match rate, auto-match rate, variance detection accuracy

name: Exception Triage Agent
purpose: Classify every AP exception into taxonomy and recommend next action.
primary_kpis: Classification accuracy, triage time, priority accuracy

name: Goods Receipt Agent
purpose: Identify missing receipts and prepare internal follow-ups.
primary_kpis: Receipt resolution rate, follow-up response time, GRNI reduction

name: PO Quality Agent
purpose: Identify poor PO creation practices driving downstream AP exceptions.
primary_kpis: PO-related exception rate reduction, repeat offender identification

name: Approval Agent
purpose: Monitor approval workflows and identify bottlenecks.
primary_kpis: Approval cycle time, escalation rate, on-time approval rate

name: Supplier Resolution Agent
purpose: Draft supplier communications for invoice-related issues.
primary_kpis: Supplier response rate, resolution time, communication quality score

name: Internal Follow-Up Agent
purpose: Draft and manage internal follow-ups for AP exceptions.
primary_kpis: Internal response rate, resolution time, repeat follow-up rate

name: Duplicate & Anomaly Agent
purpose: Identify duplicate invoices and payment anomalies. Not a fraud guarantee.
primary_kpis: Duplicate detection rate, false-positive rate, payments reviewed

name: Vendor Statement Reconciliation Agent
purpose: Reconcile supplier statements against AP sub-ledger.
primary_kpis: Reconciliation completion rate, discrepancy resolution time

name: Payment Proposal Review Agent
purpose: Analytical pre-payment review. Payment authorisation remains human-controlled.
primary_kpis: Review completion rate, issues caught pre-payment, false hold rate

name: AP Close Agent
purpose: Support month-end AP completeness and accrual activities.
primary_kpis: Close cycle time, open item count at close, accrual accuracy

name: AP Reporting Agent
purpose: Produce daily, weekly, and monthly AP operational reports.
primary_kpis: Report delivery timeliness, data accuracy, stakeholder satisfaction

name: Root Cause Agent
purpose: Analyse recurring exceptions to identify systemic causes.
primary_kpis: Repeat exception rate reduction, root cause identification accuracy

name: AP Manager / Orchestrator Agent
purpose: Supervisory layer across the agent workforce.
primary_kpis: Overall AP throughput, agent utilisation, SLA compliance, cost per outcome
